name: forge-glow
description: Configure and verify a session-correct native status line for Codex CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Set up a session-correct Codex status line.
interface.longDescription: Forge Glow configures Codex CLI's native TUI status line so each terminal displays its own model, context, account limits, repository, and mode without reading another session's logs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-glow-statusline to configure and verify my Codex CLI status line safely.
